column1: # Game profile of The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild (Switch, base game v0 + update 1.9.0 = v1114112). In bring-up
# Nintendo EPD's engine (sead / agl / gsys / ksys, NintendoWare G3d / Ui2d / Vfx / Atk, Havok), SDK 20.5.22, NVN; modules main + subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_movie) + sdk.

# RomFS is almost all Yaz0 (.s* extensions) and SARC (Pack/*.pack). Shaders: Shader/*.sbfsha (BNSH) and the gsys / ksys resource packs in Pack/Bootup_Graphics.pack, the terrain resource pack in TitleBG.pack, particle effects in Effect/*.sesetlist, layouts in .sblarc

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)

column2: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild

column1: # the virtual gamepad starts in the 3D layout (D-pad, right stick, L3 / R3): the right stick turns the camera
# Native aspect: 3D follows the display; font and layout draws retain their proportions in a centered 16:9 region. DM_ASPECT=0 disables it.
# These are all vertex shaders of main's font (BNSH@0x1d7a000) and layout (BNSH@0x1d83000) libraries, from shader_map.tsv.
# The final agl composite samples the UI canvas; captures inside that canvas remain in their original coordinate system.
# The main camera is a sead::PerspectiveProjection at +0x38 in the singleton at main+0x1e39d10 (vtable main+0x1d05380, aspect +0xb0, dirty +8); 1.9.0 build cd57b23fa4bbad65803d9788c01821ee.
# UI model camera update at main+0xd44a2c: x19 owns the source camera (+0xa0) and projection (+0xa8); source fovy/offsets are at +0x74.
# BOTW 1.9.0 CameraChase polar update; direct angular deltas at 180 degrees per normalized short edge.
# CameraTail is the active camera action on ordinary wall climbs.
# The frame-interval controller (60 fps cuts in patch_nso.py) and dynamic resolution read the GPU time between the frame's two timestamp reports: each report takes its segment's GPU start / end
# 60 fps (30 on the Switch): the host decides each frame's step in whole vsyncs and holds the frame that long (rewriter stubs at setWaitVsyncInterval and VFR::updateInterval,
# patch_nso.py FRAME_STEP); 30 when 60 does not hold, game time = real time. DM_FPS_TARGET=30 (Documents/env.txt on the iPhone) saves power; 0 runs the game's own
# interval controller (with the 60 fps cuts, which also serve while the game's VFR override is set)
# only the merged 1.9.0 copy is extracted; the base game's own build IDs are added when needed

# The NPDM declares no system resource (META +0x14 = 0): the game uses SetHeapSize. Starts from 13 Sentinels' partition (4 GB block = 256 MB in front + 256 MB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 3.25 GB heap region) until measured
